title: Metaculus Personal Forecast Volume by Horizon
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:personal horizon_bucket=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as metric by _time horizon_bucket
| sort 0 _time horizon_bucket
description: Trends monthly forecast count by horizon bucket for personal forecasting.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether personal forecasting are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `horizon_bucket` on `forecast:personal` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly forecast count.
visualization: Line chart of monthly forecast count by horizon bucket.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how forecast count changes month by month for each horizon bucket so you can see whether personal forecasting are heading the right way.
